name: Hearts & Minds
source: Living life with busy, travelling parents is not easy - especially if one of them is in the military. After your Dad leaves, things seem to fall apart. The easiest way to ease it all is to solidify relationships with the people around you.
translation: 父母工作繁忙、经常在外奔波，和这样的父母生活并不容易——尤其当其中一人还是军人时。父亲离开后，一切似乎都开始分崩离析。想让生活好过一些，最简单的办法，就是加深与身边人的关系。
